sources: ../_shared/owner-approvals-2026-11-24b.md (labs workspace, outside this repository), sections 1 and 7
owner_approval.viral_real_data_quoted: VIRAL | SNAP or Netzschleuder networks with an explicit licence that permits research use | Stay synthetic
owner_approval.viral_amendments_quoted: Per-probability contrasts are primary, R = 120, with Holm. Threshold grid 0.18 to 0.30. A new master seed. Specify the Holm interval method.

real_data.licence_check: SNAP and Netzschleuder: no explicit dataset licence (not adopted as sources). Netzschleuder entry facebook_friends -> upstream github.com/benmaier/BFMaierFBnetwork, MIT License: clean, adopted (D-008).
real_data.dataset: maier_fb (pinned commit d1446af55483c98d93f72015b6238200e1a30575), 362 nodes, 1988 edges, 97,876-byte GML (99,738 bytes with LICENSE and README)
real_data.role: EXP-005 only: calibration of the transmission grid from the degree sequence (p_c) and a second test against real_er and real_dpr nulls. Never used by EXP-001 to EXP-004; the fit does not use the primary contrast.
real_data.committed: provenance, SHA-256 values and aggregate statistics only; data/raw/ and data/processed/ git-ignored

amendments_applied.A-1: Per-p contrasts primary: 14 contrasts (WS, BA vs ER x 7 p), one Holm family at 0.05; grid mean secondary (protocol 11.1; EXP-002 A-1)
amendments_applied.A-4: New master seeds: EXP-002 and EXP-004 20261125, EXP-003 20261126, EXP-005 20261128; pilot seed was 20261124 (protocol 11.2)
amendments_applied.A-5: Holm interval method specified and implemented (protocol 11.3; viral.stats.holm_bootstrap_contrasts)
amendments_applied.note: The interval construction, the per-multiplier reading of EXP-004 S1 and the EXP-004 seed choice were made by the AI assistant at the freeze, before any confirmatory value was seen (D-009). Not applied because not on the approved list: D-007 A4 (LT depth definition; D = T by construction is disclosed) and A6 (budget stays 4 h).

common_decisions.C1: Data: real data as approved (the maier_fb network, EXP-005 only, D-008); synthetic otherwise (EXP-001 to EXP-004).
common_decisions.C2: PDFs: built with pandoc and Typst (-V mainfont="Libertinus Serif"); no LaTeX on the machine.
common_decisions.C3: Authorship: "Mohamed Bechir Kefi", no affiliation. The AI is disclosed as a research and development assistant, not as an author (CITATION.cff, manuscript metadata).
common_decisions.C4: Disclosure: exploratory values of the primary contrast were seen before the freeze, all on master seed 20261124 (disjoint from every confirmatory seed). (1) Smoke run EXP-001-20261124T162117Z-99c548ac (R = 5, p in {0, 0.05, 0.2, 1}): BA - ER at p = 0.2 = 0.1127, WS - ER at p = 0.2 = -0.0878; stored in results/exploratory/EXP-001/EXP-001-20261124T162117Z-99c548ac/tables/contrasts_by_param.csv. (2) Planning probe EXP-001-20261124T162121Z-d947f41d (R = 10, full EXP-002 p grid): BA - ER per p (0.02 to 0.5) = 0.00002, 0.00035, 0.0061, 0.0548, 0.1019, -0.0540, -0.0445; WS - ER = 0.000004, -0.00002, -0.0004, -0.0047, -0.0835, -0.3564, 0.0531; grid means BA - ER 0.0092, WS - ER -0.0560; stored in results/exploratory/EXP-001/EXP-001-20261124T162121Z-d947f41d/tables/contrasts_by_param.csv and contrasts.csv. The probe also ran LT at phi in {0.10, 0.14, 0.18, 0.22, 0.26} (EXP-003 values at 0.18, 0.22, 0.26 seen; same run, tables/cells.csv). These values motivated A-1, A-2 and A-3 (D-007). No EXP-004 sensitivity or EXP-005 real-network diffusion value has been computed. None of these values is evidence for any hypothesis.

EXP-001.type: exploratory (not confirmatory; hash recorded for completeness; no config is frozen, so run refuses any confirmatory EXP-001 config)

EXP-005.type: confirmatory (second test on a real network)

git_revision.note: freeze-prep commit holding the frozen protocol, configs and code; this record is committed on top of it

guard: viral run accepts a confirmatory config only if its file SHA-256 is listed here for its experiment and the study protocol, experiment protocol and data manifest hashes match (src/viral/protocol_gate.py; tests/test_realdata_freeze.py).
